people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
translations.bsb: So too, when a Levite came to that spot and saw him, he passed by on the other side.
translations.kjv: And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side.
translations.asv: And in like manner a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.
